description: This file contains Python classes and methods for reading, writing, and managing Visual Studio project files, including classes for tools, filters, and project writers.

classes.name: Tool
classes.description: Represents a Visual Studio tool with a name and optional attributes, capable of generating its XML element.

classes.name: Filter
classes.description: Represents a virtual folder or filter in Visual Studio projects, can contain files or other filters.

classes.name: Writer
classes.description: Handles writing Visual Studio project files in XML format, managing configurations, files, and associated tools.
